title: test_authentication_login_and_email_verification
description: Verify that users can log in with valid credentials and receive an authenticated session or token, and that email verification with valid and invalid tokens behaves as expected, including access control to protected dashboard endpoints.

title: test_news_management_crud_and_media_handling
description: Test creating, editing, publishing, and retrieving news stories with media attachments, including validation errors for missing fields and unsupported media types.

title: test_program_management_crud_and_status_toggle
description: Validate creation, retrieval, and status toggling of programs with proper authorization and handling of invalid or incomplete payloads.

title: test_project_management_slug_generation_and_relationships
description: Ensure projects can be created with slug generation linked to programs, updated with slug preservation or regeneration, and handle validation errors for duplicates or missing relationships.

title: test_service_management_crud_and_authorization
description: Verify CRUD operations for services including creation, update, retrieval, validation errors, and authorization enforcement on deletion.

title: test_team_members_crud_and_photo_uploads
description: Test creating, updating, and retrieving team member profiles with photo uploads, including handling unsupported image formats and authorization on deletion.

title: test_governance_documents_upload_and_filtering
description: Validate uploading governance documents with categories and files, retrieving documents by category, and handling validation errors for missing or disallowed files.

title: test_survey_system_submission_and_throttling
description: Test creating surveys, submitting valid and invalid responses, enforcing throttling limits, and retrieving survey analytics.

title: test_contact_messages_submission_and_spam_protection
description: Verify public contact form submissions with honeypot spam protection, retrieval of messages by admins, and authorization enforcement on deletion.

title: test_homepage_sections_and_hero_slides_management
description: Test creating and reordering homepage hero slides and sections, including validation errors for missing images and invalid reorder payloads.
